name: Capital Subsidy to Existing Hotels for Renovation/Modernization & Upgradation
benefit:
##### **Subsidy For Upgradation To Deluxe Hotels**
Existing standard hotels (minimum 50 rooms) and mini resorts (minimum 20 rooms) upgrading to Deluxe Hotels/Resorts are eligible for capital subsidy as per the tourism policy under such category.
##### **Subsidy For Upgradation To 4-Star or Higher**
Existing Deluxe hotels and resorts upgrading to 4-star or higher category Hotels (minimum 75 rooms)
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an existing Standard Hotel or Mini Resort to apply for Category A upgradation. - The applicant must ensure the upgraded facility meets the criteria for Deluxe Hotels (minimum 50 rooms) or Resorts (minimum 20 rooms) under Category A. - The applicant must make a minimum investment of ₹10,00,00,000/- to be eligible for the subsidy under Category A. - The applicant must be an existing Deluxe Hotel or Resort to apply for Category B upgradation. - The applicant must ensure the upgraded facility meets the criteria for 4-star or higher category Hotels (minimum 75 rooms) or Resorts (minimum 25 rooms) under Category B. - The applicant must make a minimum investment of ₹25,00,00,000/- to be eligible for the subsidy under Category B. - The applicant must claim subsidy only on capital investment made after the enforcement of this Policy. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must not claim Investment Promotion Assistance if they are claiming capital subsidy under this policy.
